summary.name: Transmit 5
summary.one_liner: Transmit 5 is Panic's macOS file transfer app for managing files on FTP, SFTP, WebDAV, S3 and many cloud storage servers through a dual-pane interface.
keywords: alternative to finder for remote files
use_cases: Uploading and downloading files to web servers
Connecting to multiple cloud storage services from one app
summary.what_it_does: Transmit is a macOS app for connecting to servers and cloud services to upload, download, and manage files. It supports FTP, SFTP, WebDAV, and Amazon S3, plus cloud services such as Backblaze B2, Box, Google Drive, Dropbox, and Microsoft Azure. Its dual-pane interface is presented as a faster alternative to Finder for remote files. File Sync can mirror local-to-local, local-to-remote, or remote-to-remote folders, and Panic Sync keeps saved servers across computers. Transmit 5 also adds batch rename, a Get Info sidebar, a Places bar, and an activity view.
notable: Dual-pane file browser presented as faster than Finder
File Sync for local-local, local-remote and remote-remote folder mirroring
Panic Sync to sync saved servers across computers
Supports FTP, SFTP, WebDAV, S3 and many cloud services
caveats: Full version works for 7 days as a trial; keeping it costs $45 or requires an unlock code purchase
